rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice in spoken Hong Kong Cantonese for an ambulance.

example.jyutping: faai3 di1 daa2 din6 waa2 giu3 baak6 ce1 laa1

rows.note: A speaker chooses this direct, neutral term when clarity or a more official tone matters rather than using 白車.

example.english: If anyone is seriously injured, please call an ambulance immediately.
example.traditional: 如有人嚴重受傷，請立即召喚救護車。
example.jyutping: jyu4 jau5 jan4 jim4 zung6 sau6 soeng1 cing2 laap6 zik1 ziu1 wun6 gau3 wu6 ce1
